pages.lesson:
LESSON: LISTENING 14.1.1 CONSONANT SOUNDS AND INTONATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.1: Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can one learn to correctly pronounce words?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify words with the sounds /v/, /f/, /n/ and /ŋ/ from a text
2. use correct intonation for yes/no and wh- questions in varied contexts
3. appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation and intonation in a conversation

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: LISTENING 14.1.1 CONSONANT SOUNDS AND INTONATION
This lesson teaches Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify words with the sounds /v/, /f/, /n/ and /ŋ/ from a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use correct intonation for yes/no and wh- questions in varied contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation and intonation in a conversation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation above.
2. Explain Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Listening 14.1.1 Consonant Sounds and Intonation important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can one learn to correctly pronounce words?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify words with the sounds /v/, /f/, /n/ and /ŋ/ from a text
2. use correct intonation for yes/no and wh- questions in varied contexts
3. appreciate the importance of correct pronunciation and intonation in a conversation
